desc_zh: 建水古城内的百年院落，青砖天井，每晚可在天井里喝建水烤豆腐配米酒。
desc_en: A century-old courtyard within the ancient walls of Jianshui — cobblestone sky-wells and nightly tofu-and-rice-wine sessions.

desc_zh: 梯田之上的石砌小屋，私家无边际泳池俯瞰山谷，晨雾中醒来是每位住客的专属时刻。
desc_en: Stone bungalows above the terraces, a private infinity pool over the valley — waking in the mist is uniquely yours.

desc_zh: 距德天瀑布步行 10 分钟，傍晚坐在露台听见流水声。老板是当地壮族人，每晚有竹筒饭。
desc_en: Ten minutes' walk from Detian Falls — evenings on the terrace to the sound of water. The owner is Zhuang; bamboo rice every night.

desc_zh: 专业皮划艇团队，提供穿越水上洞穴的半日及全日体验，设备一流，教练均持国际认证。
desc_en: Professional kayak team for half-day and full-day cave-passage experiences; top-tier gear, internationally certified guides.

desc_zh: 云南最知名的精品酒庄之一，海拔 1300m 的葡萄园配上建筑艺术园区，可品鉴可住宿。
desc_en: One of Yunnan's finest boutique wineries — 1,300m vineyards, an art architecture park, tastings and stays available.

desc_zh: 老街区藏身小巷的家庭餐厅，主厨阿娇的虾酱蒸鱼和河内烤肉是当地食客回头率最高的两道菜。
desc_en: A family restaurant tucked in an Old Quarter alley — Chef Chio's steamed shrimp-paste fish and Hanoi grilled pork bring locals back week after week.
